f(x) = -2 \sin(\pi x)
$$

---

We are given:
$$
f(f(f(x))) = f(x)
$$
Let $ y = f(x) $. Then the equation becomes:
$$
f(f(y)) = y
$$

f(f(y)) = f(-2 \sin(\pi y)) = -2 \sin(\pi (-2 \sin(\pi y))) = -2 \sin(-2\pi \sin(\pi y)) = 2 \sin(2\pi \sin(\pi y))
